title: Fleet Farm × Milwaukee Tool
description: A short-form content series turning Milwaukee Tool's in-store footprint at Fleet Farm into scroll-stopping product stories.
overview: Fleet Farm partnered with Swipe Saturday to bring Milwaukee Tool's newest lineup to life in-store, producing a bank of short-form vertical content built for Instagram Reels and TikTok distribution across both brands' channels.
objective: Drive foot traffic to Fleet Farm locations and boost engagement on Milwaukee Tool's product drops through fast-paced, retail-native short-form video.

title: Von Maur
description: Cinematic brand storytelling for a Von Maur seasonal collection, blending fashion film pacing with retail clarity.
overview: Von Maur wanted their seasonal collection to feel like a fashion film, not a lookbook. Swipe Saturday shot on-location across two stores to capture a cinematic brand story built for web, social, and in-store screens.
objective: Elevate Von Maur's seasonal launch with premium brand film content that performs across owned channels and in-store digital signage.

title: Outlets of Des Moines
description: A destination-marketing film pairing aerial establishing shots with ground-level storefront energy to drive regional visits.
overview: Outlets of Des Moines needed content that positioned the center as a destination, not just a shopping strip. We combined FAA Part 107 drone footage with handheld storefront coverage to sell the full day-trip experience.
objective: Increase regional awareness and weekend visitation through destination-style video distributed across paid social and tourism partners.

title: Big Grove World Cup
description: Full-day event coverage capturing the energy of Big Grove's World Cup watch party, turned around same-day for social.
overview: Big Grove hosted a packed World Cup watch party and needed real-time content to keep momentum going online throughout the day. Swipe Saturday embedded on-site with a two-person crew for full coverage and rapid turnaround.
objective: Capture authentic crowd energy and turn highlight reels around same-day to maximize social relevance while the event was still trending.

title: Middlebrook Farm
description: A sweeping aerial brand film capturing the seasonal beauty of Middlebrook Farm for destination and event marketing.
overview: Middlebrook Farm wanted a signature brand film to anchor their website and event marketing. We combined FAA Part 107 aerial cinematography with golden-hour ground footage across two seasons.
objective: Produce an evergreen brand film that communicates scale and seasonal beauty to drive event bookings and farm visits.

title: Adventureland Summer Campaign
description: A season-long short-form campaign capturing ride POVs and crowd energy at Adventureland to keep ticket sales strong all summer.
overview: Adventureland brought Swipe Saturday on for a season-long content partnership, embedding on-site throughout the summer to capture rides, shows and crowd energy for a steady stream of short-form social content.
objective: Keep ticket sales strong through the summer by publishing fresh, ride-POV and crowd-energy content on a weekly cadence across Instagram and TikTok.
